turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hello there, how are you doing today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My eyes feel tired after a day at the screen. Is that normal?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Very normal. Try the twenty twenty twenty rule, every twenty minutes look at something twenty feet away for twenty seconds.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It's easy to remember, at least. Also check your screen brightness, it should roughly match the room.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Mine is probably way too bright.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's a common cause. And make sure you blink, people blink much less while staring at screens.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Should I get those blue light glasses?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The evidence for them is mixed. Breaks and better lighting usually help more. If it keeps up, see an optician.
